import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 1000010;
    static final long MOD_CONST = 1000000007L;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_p = sc.nextInt();
        int k_param = sc.nextInt();
        boolean[] visited_array = new boolean[MAX_LIMIT];

        long total_ans = 1;
        if (k_param != 0) {
            int inv_k_param = 0;
            if (k_param == 1) {
                total_ans = total_p;
            } else {
                // Find modular inverse of k_param modulo total_p
                for (int i = 1; i < total_p; i++) {
                    if ((long) i * k_param % total_p == 1) {
                        inv_k_param = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                for (int i = 1; i < total_p; i++) {
                    if (!visited_array[i]) {
                        visited_array[i] = true;
                        int count = 1;
                        int j = (int)((long)k_param * i % total_p);
                        int m = inv_k_param;
                        while (!visited_array[j]) {
                            visited_array[j] = true;
                            count++;
                            m = (int)((long)m * inv_k_param % total_p);
                            j = (int)((long)k_param * j % total_p);
                        }
                        if (m == 1) {
                            total_ans = (total_ans * total_p) % MOD_CONST;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 1; i < total_p; i++) {
                total_ans = (total_ans * total_p) % MOD_CONST;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total_ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
